_evidence: Car record (esi, 0x2c4 bytes) for 0x00411109 and its callees 0x4110dd, 0x41902e, 0x41904e, 0x418fd0; overlay on car_0041e500 (byte +0xcd: 'test 2' selects the queued branch at 0x411109 and is RMW-cleared/set, drawn clear in 3/5; bytes +0x7b bit 1 and +0xfe bit 5 (0x4110dd 'test; je' to stc) set in 3/4 so its clc exit is reached; random background: byte +0x70 takes any value). Every read is a test/cmp of a byte/word/dword, word arithmetic, or a byte store into +0x2b8..+0x2ba / dword store into +0x2ac..+0x2b4 (index ebx 0..2): nothing faults, so value lists only steer the rare conjunctions to every block. dword +0x40: 'test -1; je' at 0x41116c plus 0x4110dd's 'test 0x15000' and '(and 0x280) == 0x280' - zero in 4/10, values passing 0x4110dd (4, 0x80, 0x1000) and failing it (0x280, 0x10000, 0x15000). byte +0x84 (cmp 4/3/7 exits) draws those and 0/5/0xff. byte +0x8d (test 2 exit at 0x41114c, test 0x10 at 0x4111be) draws 0x10 in half, else 0/2/0x12. bytes +0x2b8..+0x2ba (0x41902e: cmp cl=3; 0x418fd0: 0 = free slot, == cl=0x13/3 = already queued; 0x41904e clears matches) draw 0/3/4/0x13. words: +0x90 (abs, 16-bit neg) vs +0xb0 (signed jg) draw small, both signs and 0x7fff/0x8000; +0x9a vs 0x1d5 (jge) draws the boundary 0x1d4..0x1d6 and extremes; +0xee vs 0x3000 (jl) the boundary and extremes; +0xe minus the words [+0x1c]+0 and +0x18 (|.| vs 0x2000, jge): +0xe is i16 in +-0x3000 and the dword +0x1c points at a 0x70-byte segment block of i16 values in +-0x1000 (it is dereferenced: never null, as in car_0041e500), so the difference falls on both sides of 0x2000.
